record.name: Simply: AI Contract Review
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Most people sign contracts without reading them properly. That's not laziness — legal documents are written to be hard to parse.
                        
Simply reads them for you. Upload a contract, lease, invoice, or official notice. In a few minutes you get a clear breakdown: what the document actually says, what you need to do, and what to watch out for.                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                              
WHAT YOU GET                                              
• A verdict on whether this document is straightforward or worth worrying about
• Red flags traced to the exact line that triggered them                                                                                                                    
• Deadlines you can't let slip: renewal dates, payment windows, notice periods
• Money terms laid out plainly: fees, deposits, penalties, recurring costs                                                                                                  
• Concrete next steps, including what to ask or push back on before you sign
                                                                                                                                                                              
 FOLLOW-UP Q&A                                             
 Still have questions after reading the analysis? Ask Simply directly. It answers in plain language and points to the specific section of your document.                     
                                                                                                                                                                              
EXPORT & SHARE
Add deadlines to your calendar in one tap. Export a clean summary to share with someone else or keep on file.                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                              
WHAT WE READ
Rental and commercial leases · Employment offers · Service agreements · Invoices and payment notices · Official letters and legal notices                                   
                                                                                                                                                                              
PRIVACY
Text extraction runs on your device. Simply deletes your file after analysis — it's not stored anywhere.                                                                    
                                                            
---
Not legal advice. Use it to understand what you're signing before you sign it.
                                                                                                                                                                              
Free to download. First 2 analyses included.

record.description_evidence:
OnPoint Legal Billing is built for attorneys, from solo practitioners to members of large law firms. Capture the day in your own words, and send bills written in the language clients expect.

ROUGH NOTES IN, BILL-READY LANGUAGE OUT
• Polish uses OnPoint's proprietary logic system intertwined with frontier AI to turn a rough narrative into clean billing language with one tap.
• For example, "Talked to the other side's lawyer about the fence line disagreement" quickly becomes "Conference with opposing counsel re boundary dispute"
• Your words and the rewrite appear side by side; accept it or keep yours
• Polish never invents work you didn't describe. It rephrases, nothing more

YOUR ACCOUNTS, CONNECTED
• Link your Microsoft 365 / Outlook account and OnPoint drafts entries from your calendar and mail
• Meetings become timed entries; the day's correspondence clusters by client
• Complete suggestions save in one tap. Anything less fills the capture form for your review
• Suggestions are matched to your clients on your device. When you save or use a mail suggestion, the AI writes the entry from the text of those messages, and you can turn that off

BILLS YOUR CLIENTS TAKE SERIOUSLY
• Letterhead bills in Word, PDF, or Excel with your firm header and logo
• Per-client invoice numbering, issue and due dates, and a saved invoice history
• Export through the share sheet. Attach to an email or save to Files

CAPTURE TIME THE MOMENT IT HAPPENS
• Tap a client, tap the hours, save. An entry in seconds; a built-in timer when you'd rather clock the work live
• Tenths, quarter hours, fifths or half hours, your choice
• Optional phrase chips drop in the billing language you use every day

DICTATE YOUR DAY
• Chain Dictation is a dictation room: talk through your day and AI structures every entry: client, hours, matter, narrative
• Say "next entry" and keep going; approve everything with one tap

AN ASSISTANT THAT KNOWS YOUR LEDGER
• Ask "how many hours for ABC this month?" or "email the March bill as a PDF"
• Every bulk change shows a confirmation before anything is touched

KNOW WHAT YOU'RE SITTING ON
• Home shows what's unbilled and what clients owe; Billing lists every client with unbilled time and what it comes to
• Overdue bills are flagged with day counts; Remind drafts a courteous payment reminder

YOUR WHOLE FIRM, ONE BILL
• Invite colleagues from Settings. Everyone captures against shared firm clients and matters
• A review queue for the firm's time: approve, send back, or edit. You set how many approvals an entry needs, from none to three
• Consolidated firm invoices grouped by timekeeper, with per-matter subtotals and rates frozen when the bill is issued
• Rate cards, timekeeper summaries, payment recording, and firm-wide unbilled totals

YOUR CLIENTS' BUSINESS STAYS YOURS

Basil is a private AI note taker for meetings. Recording, transcription and summaries all run on your device. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no server holding your conversations.

WHY ON-DEVICE MATTERS
Most AI note takers send your audio to a cloud service to be transcribed and summarized. Basil doesn't. Transcription runs on the Neural Engine, and summaries are generated locally by Apple Intelligence. There is no account to create, no subprocessor list, and no server to subpoena.

RECORD ANY MEETING
• In Person — capture the room with your microphone.
• Computer (Mac) — capture both sides of a Zoom, Teams or Meet call without putting a bot in the meeting. Nothing joins your call, and nothing leaves your Mac.
• Import existing audio or video files. Basil extracts the audio locally.

TRANSCRIPTS AND SUMMARIES
• A fast live transcript while you record, then a refined, higher-accuracy pass right after the session.
• Transcripts include speakers names and are fully exportable.
• Summaries, action items, decisions and follow-ups, generated on device.
• 60+ languages.
• Full-text search across everything you have recorded.

BASIL FOR LAW
A legal edition for attorneys and firms:
• Privilege attestation — an on-device provenance record documenting that a recording was captured and processed locally.
• Consent log — a timestamped attestation, built to the strictest all-party-consent standard so one workflow works in every state.
• Matters and clients — organize by matter rather than by date.
• Privileged & Confidential labeling on recordings, transcripts and exports.

These are record-keeping tools for legal professionals. They are not legal services or legal advice, and no software can guarantee a privilege outcome. Basil's contribution is architectural: your client conversations never leave your device.

ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
A universal app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Your library syncs through your own iCloud account — your iCloud, not our servers.

EXPORT
Send notes to Apple Notes, Calendar, Reminders and Files.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Basil Pro unlocks unlimited recording. Basil for Law adds the legal feature set above. Free trials are available on both. Current pricing and trial length are shown on the subscription screen in the app.

Most AI note takers send your audio to a cloud service to be transcribed and summarized. Basil doesn't. Transcription runs on the Neural Engine, and summaries are generated locally by Apple Intelligence. There is no account to create, no subprocessor list, and no server to subpoena.

RECORD ANY MEETING
• In Person — capture the room with your microphone.
• Computer (Mac) — capture both sides of a Zoom, Teams or Meet call without putting a bot in the meeting. Nothing joins your call, and nothing leaves your Mac.
• Import existing audio or video files. Basil extracts the audio locally.

TRANSCRIPTS AND SUMMARIES
• A fast live transcript while you record, then a refined, higher-accuracy pass right after the session.
• Transcripts include speakers names and are fully exportable.
• Summaries, action items, decisions and follow-ups, generated on device.
• 60+ languages.
• Full-text search across everything you have recorded.

BASIL FOR LAW
A legal edition for attorneys and firms:
• Privilege attestation — an on-device provenance record documenting that a recording was captured and processed locally.
• Consent log — a timestamped attestation, built to the strictest all-party-consent standard so one workflow works in every state.
• Matters and clients — organize by matter rather than by date.
• Privileged & Confidential labeling on recordings, transcripts and exports.

These are record-keeping tools for legal professionals. They are not legal services or legal advice, and no software can guarantee a privilege outcome. Basil's contribution is architectural: your client conversations never leave your device.

ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
A universal app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Your library syncs through your own iCloud account — your iCloud, not our servers.

EXPORT
Send notes to Apple Notes, Calendar, Reminders and Files.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Basil Pro unlocks unlimited recording. Basil for Law adds the legal feature set above. Free trials are available on both. Current pricing and trial length are shown on the subscription screen in the app.

The journey of starting and running a business is complex. Most people are left to figure it out alone. They don't need another tool. They need a guide.

ZenBusiness has spent over 10 years building what entrepreneurs need. Business formation. Registered agent and compliance services. Banking and bookkeeping. Tax filing. That's the foundation of our app.

The ZenBusiness app and platform features Velo® as the personalized AI guide that helps entrepreneurs reach their goals faster. Shaped by nearly a million businesses formed and tens of millions of real interactions, Velo knows where entrepreneurs get stuck and clears the path before they have to ask. 

Whether you're still exploring an idea or scaling across state lines, Velo adapts to you. Your stage. Your state. Your situation.

Still dreaming? Velo helps you shape the idea. Ready to plan? Velo helps you choose a business name, build your plan, and outline financial projections. 

When there's work to be done, Velo doesn't just suggest what to do. It does it on your behalf. Formation. Compliance. Business licenses. Website. You approve, Velo handles the rest. And when you need human expertise, Velo puts you in contact with our award-winning support team.

All in service of one business: Yours.

WHATEVER STAGE YOU'RE IN

• Just exploring an idea? Talk it through with Velo to figure out if it can work.
• Still figuring out the details? Velo helps plan out the steps, costs, and right way to set things up.
• Ready to make it official? We'll form your business and handle all the paperwork with the state.
• Already up and running? Velo helps you stay on top of compliance, manage your finances, and everything else.

MAKE YOUR BUSINESS OFFICIAL

• Start your LLC, S Corp, or C Corp, beginning at $0 + state fees.
• Not sure which structure is right? Velo helps you choose.
• Get your operating agreement, appoint a registered agent, and find out which licenses and permits you need.
• Every filing is backed by our 100% accuracy guarantee. 

STAY COMPLIANT, WORRY-FREE

• Get hands-on help filing annual reports and amendments, with Worry-Free Compliance to keep your business in good standing.
• Never miss an ongoing compliance filing deadline. Velo tracks annual reports, license renewals, and filing dates, and tells you when to act.

MANAGE YOUR FINANCES

• Keep your business and personal finances separate with a business bank account.
• Track expenses, send invoices, and maximize deductions with Money Pro bookkeeping.
• Get expert tax filing and advice when you need it.

GROW YOUR BUSINESS

• Build a website, register a domain name, and set up a professional email address.
• Velo adapts as you grow, so the guidance always fits where your business is now.

ALL YOUR DOCUMENTS IN ONE PLACE

• Keep your important business documents organized and easy to find, anytime.
• Easily access your personal dashboard from any device. Anywhere you go.

REAL SUPPORT WHEN YOU NEED IT

• Velo provides personalized guidance 24/7/365.
• Velo won't guess. When a question is better handled by an expert, it connects you with our award-winning support team, already up to speed on your situation.

From your initial business idea to your hundredth customer, ZenBusiness brings formation, compliance, finances, and more into one app, with Velo guiding every step.
